I asked people if it's possible to fall in love from a distance. The answers were overwhelmingly in the no.

But how does that explain my depression when I wasn't talking to him?
How I thought of him so often, pretty much all day long?
Always wondered about how he would react to things I say?
Felt intense jealousy when he talked with another woman?
How about how happy I was when we did talk again?
How hard my heart would thump whenever I heard his ringtone?
The way I'd become so breathless I read the things he wrote to me?
His hurt was mine. His problems were mine. I wanted to help him. I wanted him to be the best. I thought of no other man - they were irrelevant to me, unless they were/like a brother.

Oh, my god. I miss that man so much. I love him so much. But why? Why is it like this? I hate him, too, I really do.

He is not a good man. He is deceitful, sly, greedy, and selfish. He only sees/cares about his problems. He knows I have mine, but he's not concerned about them the way I was about his. He is narrow-mindedly obsessed. He doesn't care if he hurts anyone else in the process of getting what he wants. He knows the way he is, and he decidedly does not care anymore. He has become cruel, too. He says things only to hurt now. Not much to me, but he would. He does to others. What a mean man.

I know everyone has shortcomings. I have many. But he has too many, mainly because he gave himself permission to let them expand limitlessly.

So, he is a bad person. Yet, I still love him. I hate myself and him both for this. I am ashamed that I love this semi-abusive man. And I feel this is so, so unfair.

Do I think he would have been different if it were not long distance? Yes. I believe it became easy for him to disconnect from his emotions online. I don't think he was always this way. One day, right before my eyes, he turned around and became something worse. A bit of a monster. I kept holding on because I loved the man he was before. It's possible that he never changed - maybe he just began to show me more of himself. I'm not sure. I think the man I spoke with was more emotional, loving, and caring. And I bet if the relationship was set IRL rather than at a distance, we would have been locked into each other.

But it was not in real life, so this is irrelevant. I know he does not love me. I can see it in his indifferent behavior. There's no changing that at this point. I wish, I wish, I wish. But wishful thinking is wasteful thinking.

It hurts so damn much. Really? Unrequited love, again? This is the second time. If it happens a third time, strike three and game over for me. I won't have anything left in me.

There's no replacing nor replicating either the love or the man. I love that man whom I spoke with face-to-face, before he changed. I think about all the rich conversations we had. I gained a lot there, though I'd never admit it to him. I love flipping through memories of him teasing me; making me feel good, smart, beautiful; when he expressed concern or worry about me; when I thought it was just us two in the world; when I thought he really loved me.
I remember his pretty words, his smile, his laugh, and I love it all.
I hate it. And I hate this resultant sadness.

Please. Please just go away forever.
